'''Revelation Hunt Down And Destroy All Jedi''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 1 May 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 BHBM Revelation DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Wait a minute...this is BHBM!!!

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

First turn, pull Dannik Jerriko and Back Door. Activate. Get DS2 db. I don?t recommend deploying anything. Emperor Palpatine is going to come out of your deck when it?s appropriate for a beatdown time. Second turn, pull Blast Door Controls (evasion hate) and either Spaceport to your opponent?s planet or get the Endor db. If your opponent is ready to be attacked, do so. Otherwise, wait, perhaps draw a bit. Next turn, get Spaceport/Coruscant db. If he STILL hasn?t done ANYTHING, deploy cards. But that?s no fun. Let?s talk about stacking cards. Deploy DS2 Emperor from Reserve Deck; he grabs Force Lightning. Don?t be afraid to use the Lost gametext; you have a backup Emperor, remember. However, unless your opponent hits him, try to make him stick around until you?re out of Force Lightnings, then feel free to lose him. Try to deploy him to a juicy drain at opponent?s planet; otherwise, stick him at the Back Door. Maul plays a key backup role. This deck is pretty easy to understand; beatdown or force drain. I hate it when people track against me so that?s why I play Ommni combo x2. This deck is meant to kill all Jedi. Besides Luke, Vader can take on all Jedi. Maul takes on all Jedi; as well as Luke! Lose a force to duel them (with a tracked Ommni Box and Force Lightning), lose a force to place them out of play. The weaker characters you beatdown on. 4-LOM cancels either Jedi?s immunity, or their permanent weapons. Either way, you kill them. IG-88 just might be able to capture someone combined with a used Force Lightning. Matchups:

HB: Hope he isn?t playing Luke?hehheh.

RTP: Blast R2 to a million pieces if he?s not protecting him.

TIGIH: Outfight him; let him make the first move.

QMC: Blast Door controls= evasion killer : )

Okay, that was the ?special? strategy. The rest; just KILL!
